=== arrows
Alice -> Bob : solid
Bob --> Alice : dotted
Alice ->> Bob : async
Alice -\ Bob : top half
Alice -/ Bob : bottom half
Alice ->x Bob : lost
Alice x-> Bob
Alice <-> Bob : both
Alice o-> Bob
Alice ->o Bob
Alice o->o Bob
Alice <<-- Bob
Alice \\- Bob
Alice //- Bob
Alice <- Bob
Alice <-- Bob : reverse
Alice x<- Bob
Alice -\\ Bob
Alice -// Bob
Alice <-x Bob
Alice ox-> Bob
Alice ---> Bob
Alice -->> Bob
=== illegal arrow
Alice - Bob
=== illegal arrow dashes
Alice -- Bob
=== colored
Alice -[#red]> Bob : red
Alice -[#blue]-> Bob
Alice -[dashed]> Bob
Alice -[dotted,#green]> Bob
Alice -[hidden]> Bob
Alice -[bold]> Bob
Alice -[#red,#blue]> Bob
Alice <-[#0000FF]- Bob
=== colored bad
Alice -[plain]> Bob
=== colored unknown
Alice -[#nosuch]> Bob
=== self
Alice -> Alice : think
Alice <- Alice
Alice --> Alice : dotted self
=== quoted participants
"Long A" -> "Long B" : x
"Long A" as A -> B as "Long B"
A -> "Long B"
C as "Cc" -> D
=== multiline label
Alice -> Bob : line1\nline2\nline3
Alice -> Bob : <b>bold</b> and **creole**
Alice -> Bob : tab\there
Alice -> Bob : left\lright\r
=== no label
Alice -> Bob
Alice -> Bob :
Alice -> Bob :   
=== stereotype message
Alice -> Bob <<create>> : x
Alice -> Bob <<x>>
=== url message
Alice -> Bob [[http://x.com]] : link
Alice -> Bob [[http://x.com{tip}]]
=== parallel
Alice -> Bob : one
& Alice -> Carol : two
&Bob -> Carol
=== parallel first
& Alice -> Bob
=== anchors
{start} Alice -> Bob : start
Bob -> Alice : middle
{end} Bob -> Alice : finish
{start} <-> {end} : some time
{a}<->{b}
=== part anchors
Alice {p1} -> Bob {p2} : x
=== multicast
Alice -> Bob & Carol & Dave : multi
=== inclination
Alice ->(10) Bob : slanted
Alice (10)<- Bob
Alice ->(5) Bob
=== slanted
Alice ->(30) Bob : x
Alice (30)-> Bob
=== short with dots
A.b -> C@d : x
=== autoactivate
autoactivate on
Alice -> Bob : call
Bob --> Alice : ret
Alice ->> Bob : async
Alice ->x Bob
autoactivate off
Alice -> Bob
=== activation shortcuts
Alice -> Bob ++ : act
Bob -> Carol ++ #red : act2
Carol --> Bob -- : ret
Bob --> Alice -- : ret
Alice -> Dave ** : create
Alice -> Dave !! : destroy
Alice -> Eve --++ : both
Alice -> Eve ++-- : both2
=== activation color
Alice -> Bob ++ #gold
Alice -> Bob ++ #nosuch
=== long line
Alice -> Bob : 
=== variable autonumber
autonumber
Alice -> Bob : msg %autonumber%
Bob -> Alice : again %autonumber%
